title: K-Beauty up 200 pc, men’s skincare 78 pc: Gen Z reshapes Myntra’s beauty mix
summary: Gen Z is reshaping Myntra’s beauty business, contributing to substantial growth in various skincare and grooming categories. Demand for K-Beauty products and men's grooming has seen significant increases, reflecting changing consumer preferences. The beauty market in India is projected to grow substantially, driven by increasing per-capita spending. Myntra is enhancing its domestic brand portfolio and expanding quick-commerce offerings to meet evolving consumer needs.
